title: Sarbacher's secret atomic lab in Washington DC

tellings.quote: It was published in the paper that he had asked for a renewal of a permit to pursue atomic research at this residential address in Washington DC,

plain: In the 1950s, a scientist named Robert Sarbacher ran a secret atomic lab at a house in Washington DC. The researcher Jan Lundquist says a newspaper reported that Sarbacher had asked to renew a permit "to pursue atomic research at this residential address," though Lundquist does not name the paper. He offers it as a sign of hidden research going on in plain sight.
